description: Flash-frozen in liquid nitrogen (-196 C) immediately after cutting.
details: Best preservation of labile metabolites. Needs a dewar; keep frozen until extraction.
Easier logistics than liquid N2; slower freezing.

description: Dried with silica gel at ambient temperature.
details: Cheap, no cold chain. Drying takes 24-72 h; some volatile or labile compounds lost.
Heat may degrade compounds. Parameters on the Oven drying page (type, temperature, duration).

description: Dried at ambient temperature in the shade.
details: Slow; enzymatic changes possible. Parameters on the Air drying page (place, temperature, duration).

description: Tissue placed directly into extraction solvent in the field.
details: Stops metabolism instantly. Parameters on the Field extraction page.
Compounds leach into the ethanol. Parameters on the Ethanol page (concentration, volume, storage, use of the liquid).
For combined RNA work; may affect metabolite profiles. Parameters on the RNAlater page.
